findings.description: The matcher was switched from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch (whole-string match), a behavior change the commit title does not mention.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") and an exception whose str is "Connection refused". The old self.match.match returned a match, so the exception was retried. With fullmatch the pattern must cover the entire message, so it returns False and the exception is not retried. Impact: existing callers that rely on prefix or substring-style patterns silently stop retrying, so retries are skipped without any error.
